File list

All 55 Lua Lua files in total ( 13,580 lines). "Classes" is the number of control classes defined in the file; "Functions" counts their declared methods plus file-level exported functions.

(root directory) 1 files

FileLinesClassFunctionsDescription
core.lua69—0Framework entry point: sets CHILI_DIRNAME/SKIN_DIRNAME, VFS.Includes the headers and controls in order, and returns Chili.

Controls 28 files

FileLinesClassFunctionsDescription
Controls/LayoutPanel.lua976LayoutPanel28Implements the LayoutPanel base class for every auto-layout panel: lays out children with cell grids or flow algorithms and provides selection handling, hit testing and drawing hooks.
Controls/button.lua55Button5Defines the Button base class: tracks the pressed state and repaints, while the look is supplied by the skin/theme.
Controls/checkbox.lua59Checkbox5Defines the Checkbox class: toggles checked, fires OnChange on change, and leaves the box look to the theme.
Controls/colorbars.lua100Colorbars5Color bars control: four horizontal bars adjust the RGBA components and a swatch on the right previews the current color.
Controls/combobox.lua191ComboBox6Drop-down selector control: inherits from Button and lists the items in a pop-up Window + ScrollPanel when clicked.
Controls/control.lua1,211Control65Defines Control, the base class for all visible controls (an Object subclass): padding and client area, relative coordinate constraints, autosize layout, drag and resize, cached display-list drawing, hit testing and mouse event dispatch.
Controls/editbox.lua887EditBox25Defines the EditBox class: the full text editing control, including logical/physical line layout, cursor and selection, mouse/keyboard handling, clipboard and IME input.
Controls/font.lua287Font11Defines the Font class: manages loading/unloading of engine font handles and provides measuring, word wrap, alignment math and drawing (plus the Print/PrintInBox aliases).
Controls/grid.lua9Grid0Defines Grid, a LayoutPanel subclass that stretches children into an evenly sized row/column grid (resizeItems=true, itemPadding 0).
Controls/image.lua112Image6Defines the Image class (inherits Button): draws file/file2 textures with aspect keeping, vertical flipping and OnClick support.
Controls/imagelistview.lua281ImageListView9Defines ImageListView, which scans a VFS directory and shows images as icon-plus-filename items with directory navigation, file lookup and selection.
Controls/label.lua98Label4Defines the Label class: an auto-sizing static text label that measures, wraps and draws its text.
Controls/line.lua16Line0Separator control: a 100x1 pixel line by default, used to separate layout regions.
Controls/multiprogressbar.lua165Multiprogressbar2Multi-segment progress bar control: draws color/texture segments from the bars list, horizontally or vertically and optionally reversed.
Controls/object.lua984Object63Defines Object, the object base class of Chili UI: parent-child hierarchy, visibility and layering, listener and child event dispatch, coordinate conversion, and the mouse/keyboard event entry points.
Controls/panel.lua14Panel0Minimal empty panel container drawn only by skins, with no extra logic.
Controls/progressbar.lua144Progressbar7Single-value progress bar control: fills a horizontal or vertical block between min and max according to value and shows a centered caption.
Controls/scale.lua106Scale2Ruler control: draws horizontal tick lines and numeric labels, either linear or non-linear via a custom scaleFunction.
Controls/screen.lua306Screen20Defines Screen, the UI root node (an Object subclass): screen size and coordinate conversion, plus hovered/focused/active control state, tooltips and mouse/keyboard event dispatch.
Controls/scrollpanel.lua390ScrollPanel20Scrollable container control: computes the content area from the children extents, shows horizontal/vertical scrollbars as needed and provides smooth scrolling plus scrollbar dragging.
Controls/stackpanel.lua40StackPanel2Defines StackPanel, a LayoutPanel subclass that stacks children in a single row or column, pinning the direction through rows/columns.
Controls/tabbar.lua81TabBar3Tab bar control: generates TabBarItem children from tabs and handles selection changes and OnChange notifications.
Controls/tabbaritem.lua32TabBarItem2A single tab button inside a tab bar; clicking it asks the parent TabBar to select it.
Controls/textbox.lua54TextBox1Defines the TextBox class (inherits EditBox): read-only multi-line text display that auto-heights itself.
Controls/trackbar.lua151Trackbar9Trackbar control: converts the mouse x position into a value between min and max, rounded to step, and fires OnChange.
Controls/treeview.lua115TreeView5Defines TreeView, which creates the root node, parses the initial node table, manages node selection and fits its height to the tree contents.
Controls/treeviewnode.lua377TreeViewNode23Defines TreeViewNode, covering child management, expand/collapse, recursive lookup, collapse-button interaction and drawing for tree nodes.
Controls/window.lua79Window5Window control: a draggable/resizable/click-to-front top-level container whose title bar and border are drawn by skins; TweakDraw is used for layout debugging.

Handlers 6 files

FileLinesClassFunctionsDescription
Handlers/debughandler.lua448—4Chili debugging support: registers every chili object, produces truncated stack traces, catches errors through the xpcall-based SafeCall, and disposes a widget's owned objects when it is removed.
Handlers/fonthandler.lua80—3Font cache with reference counting: reuses gl.LoadFont results by name, size and outline args, releasing them lazily in Update once the reference count reaches zero.
Handlers/skinhandler.lua181—4Skin management: loads skin.lua configs from the skin directories, resolves depend inheritance and translates image paths, then merges per-class/ancestor/general defaults into controls.
Handlers/taskhandler.lua121—5Update scheduling: collects objects requesting Update or InstantUpdate, invokes them in batch from TaskHandler.Update every frame, and broadcasts object destruction events.
Handlers/texturehandler.lua145—3Asynchronous texture loader: caches texture display lists, draws a placeholder and queues requests for missing ones, then loads them within a per-frame time slice and Invalidates the requesters.
Handlers/themehandler.lua6—0Placeholder: VFS.Include's themes/theme.lua, exposing the skin config as the global theme table.

Headers 8 files

FileLinesClassFunctionsDescription
Headers/autolocalizer.lua190—3Overrides VFS.Include/VFS.LoadFile to auto-localize global namespace accesses at load time for speed.
Headers/backwardcompability.lua20—1Backward-compatibility fixup that migrates legacy flat font/color fields into obj.font.
Headers/links.lua111—5Creates weak/hard proxy links between parent and child objects to break reference cycles that would block GC.
Headers/skinutils.lua1,228—25Skin drawing toolkit: GL draw functions for each control, nine-patch tiled and border drawing, non-client hit testing and relative-coordinate helpers.
Headers/strict.lua26—0Returns MakeStrict, which installs an __index metamethod on an environment and errors out on reads of undeclared globals (only enabled for debugging in core.lua).
Headers/unicode.lua120—5UTF-8 encoding/decoding and per-character editing helpers.
Headers/util.lua428—44General-purpose helpers: relative-coordinate and color conversion, rectangles and the scissor stack, type checks, plus string/table/math extensions.
Headers/zkcompat.lua93—0Added compatibility layer: supplies Spring.Utilities.CopyTable / Spring.ScaledGetMouseState / Spring.GetViewSizes / Spring.Orig for non-ZK engines so chili loads in any Recoil game.

Themes 1 files

FileLinesClassFunctionsDescription
Themes/theme.lua61—2Theme table and default-skin selection: defines theme.skin (default Evolved) and provides GetDefaultSkin and LoadThemeDefaults.

Skins 11 files

FileLinesClassFunctionsDescription
Skins/Blueprint/skin.lua224—0Blueprint style: dark blue background, thin white frames and a bright blue focus, like a technical drawing.
Skins/BubbleBlack/skin.lua49—0Black bubble buttons: depends on Carbon, only turns text white and swaps the button texture for rounded bubbles.
Skins/Carbon/skin.lua276—0Dark metal look: white borders, bright blue focus, heavier text contrast for dark HUDs.
Skins/DarkGlass/skin.lua55—0Dark variant of Glass: translucent dark glass panels with white text.
Skins/DarkHive/skin.lua201—0Dark hive panels: translucent dark grey background, white text, honeycomb border texture.
Skins/DarkHiveSquare/skin.lua37—0Square-cornered DarkHive variant: overrides only button / button_disabled / panel blocks, the rest comes from DarkHive.
Skins/Evolved/skin.lua756—0The richest set: dark panels with an orange focus highlight, a bundled font and many fields Merge-reused from default.
Skins/Glass/skin.lua243—0Light translucent glass: dark text, pale blue focus and glossy panels, made for bright backgrounds.
Skins/Robocracy/skin.lua276—0Amber mechanical style: bundled n019003l font, warm yellow highlight, chunky panels.
Skins/Twilight/skin.lua80—0Twilight palette: cyan borders and a translucent dark blue background, depends on DarkGlass.
Skins/default/skin.lua736—23default skin implementation: drawing functions for every control plus the skin default tables (skin.general, skin.button, skin.window, ...).
